guidance.statement: FY27e EBITDA margin of 21-22%, rising to ~23% by FY28e
Target ~1% margin improvement in FY28 through operating leverage
Maintain net cash position post all strategic actions
IGI average annual investment to remain ~US$70 million
Target 1 IND filing every year starting FY27
Branded portfolio to exceed 70% of revenue by FY30e

operating_notes.text: Glenmark US launched Vancomycin Hydrochloride for Injection USP addressing a USD 37.9 million market.
IGI announced ISB 2301, a first-in-class multispecific immune cells activator targeting solid tumors, with IND filing planned for late 2026.
Glenmark USA agreed to settle antitrust lawsuits with state attorneys general for USD 29.63 million over 5 years, which is fully provided for.
Glenmark agreed to transfer its Nebulizer brands/IP portfolio to wholly owned subsidiary GHL for ₹223 Cr.
Glenmark US launched Lacosamide Injection USP addressing an estimated $15.2 million market.
India business grew 1.5x above IPM over the last three years, with 16 brands above ₹500 million and 11 above ₹1,000 million.
RYALTRIS® has US$300 million cumulative global sales as of FY26, with estimated peak sales of US$250-300 million.
ISB 2001 has dosed over 145 subjects in the TRIgnite-1 Phase 1 study, with RP2D targeted by 4Q 2026.

timeline.summary: Glenmark US subsidiary launched Vancomycin Hydrochloride for Injection USP targeting a USD 37.9 million market.
Glenmark's Ichnos Glenmark Innovation announced ISB 2301 as a new development candidate targeting solid tumors, with an IND filing planned for later in the year.
Glenmark Pharmaceuticals announced a USD 29.63 million antitrust settlement by its US subsidiary with state attorneys general.
Glenmark Pharmaceuticals approved the transfer of its nebulizer brands and IP portfolio to its wholly owned subsidiary Glenmark Healthcare Limited for ₹223 Cr.
Glenmark reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹3,770.60 Cr (+15.8% YoY) and full-year FY26 revenue of ₹16,982.50 Cr.
Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited uploaded Q4 FY 2025-26 earnings call recording on June 1, 2026, signed by Rashmi Khandelwal, ACS-28839.
Glenmark Pharmaceuticals announced the US launch of Lacosamide Injection USP, targeting a $15.2 million market.

upcoming_events.description: Expected completion of nebulizer business transfer to GHL
